column3: (Storable/Cacheable Content) — static assets are deliberately cached; API responses are deliberately no-store.
(Base64 Disclosure) — heuristic match on base64-looking strings in JS bundles; false-positive prone, not an actual secret leak.
(Modern Web Application) — informational only; confirms the app is an SPA, not a finding to act on.
(Sub Resource Integrity Attribute Missing) — needs a Vite SRI plugin to hash-sign build output; a build-tooling change, not a header fix.
(Sec-Fetch-Dest Header is Missing) — this is a request header the browser sends; not something the server can set.
